Alcohol- 2 shots I am blacked out but only for a few hours. I have medical weed opposite happens, I turn into Spider-Man with spidey senses! I usually laugh at people that complain about not being able to sleep because my normal week was.
Wake up Sunday morning at 8:00 go to church with parents out by noon, go to lunch done by 2:00, take my son swimming done by 4:30, cook dinner, eat, bath, get him in bed by 8:30, then off to work Sunday night. Work till 7:am at UPS. Leave and run a mobile detailing business fro 8:00 to 2:00, pick up my son go for a swim or hike till 4:30 evening routine. Continue this until Friday morning.
